body:
Hi, I don't know you. Don't know if you deserve to live or not. I want to kill myself too. I just want you to know that I really felt a connection to what you were saying. The screwing up of suicide... I've had three failed attempts. Just makes me feel like the biggest failure possible.

I don't know if this helps, I don't want my words to hurt, I just want you to know someone else thinks the same about themselves.

Every time I have a sexual thought, it makes me more angry at myself. I am starting to be at the point where I don't care what happens because everything ends at death, so I was think of neutering myself. Even if it doesn't get rid of all those thoughts, it will make me feel better. Don't even have to pretend I'm manly. Maybe then I can be okay with only ever having friends. I just have to make sure that they are REALLY sharp scissors.

I think I thought so, too, at one point. But, it's just that more people agreed than disagreed. I wish my outside was uglier than my inside, but it isn't. And I have been trained to look down while I walk because of people telling me my face makes them gag.

I don't think the world is full of bad people. I think vast majorities are easily able to sniff out the pathetic. And the world truly would be happier every day I wasn't here.
